api document of class com.networknt.sche:
* This is the core of json constraint implementation. It parses json constraint
 * file and generates JsonValidators. The class is thread safe, once it is
 * constructed, it can be used to validate multiple json data concurrently.
api document of method initializeValidat:
* Initializes the validators' {@link com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema} instances. * For avoiding issues with concurrency, in 1.0.49 the {@link com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema} instances affiliated with * validators were modified to no more preload the schema and lazy loading is used instead. *

This comes with the issue that this way you cannot rely on validating important schema features, in particular * $ref resolution at instantiation from {@link com.networknt.schema.JsonSchemaFactory}.

*

By calling initializeValidators you can enforce preloading of the {@link com.networknt.schema.JsonSchema} * instances of the validators.
